Name: I Hate The Antichrist
Author: qasdxzaq
Description:
Adds corn syrup and high fructose corn syrup. Also a UN peacekeeper helmet.

Requires Content Patcher and Cornucopia - Artisan Machines.

Corn syrup is made by putting corn flour into a preserves jar.

High fructose corn syrup is made by putting 2 corn syrup in a keg.

The peacekeeper helmet is sold by hat mouse or tailored with either corn syrup.

This is my first mod.

Downloads.Description: added tailoring recipe (corn syrup or high fructose corn syrup)
